en: Fixed `--forward-subagent-text` stream-json and SDK output dropping the messages of subagents spawned by a `context: fork` skill, and of forked skills invoked by a subagent or another forked skill
zh: 修复 `--forward-subagent-text` 的 stream-json 和 SDK 输出丢失由 `context: fork` skill 生成的 subagent 消息，以及由 subagent 或其他 forked skill 调用的 forked skill 消息的问题
